what: Cummins makes diesel and natural gas engines, and the components around them: turbochargers, filtration, emission systems and generators. It also builds electric drivetrains and electrolysers through its Accelera unit.
customers: Truck and bus manufacturers, construction and farm equipment makers, data centre operators buying backup generators, and marine and rail customers.
money: turbochargers, fuel systems, emission controls and filtration
diesel and natural gas engines for trucks and equipment
parts and service through its own network
generators and power generation for data centres
moat: Engines designed into truck platforms and serviced through its own distribution network for decades, with emissions know-how that is costly to replicate.
risks: North American truck orders have been weak and revenue fell slightly last year
Emission regulation changes force expensive redesigns
A freight recession reduces both new engines and parts demand
opportunities: Power Systems is growing quickly on data centre backup generator demand
Parts and service revenue is steadier than new engine sales
Return on invested capital near 15% is good for a heavy manufacturer
watch: Power Systems revenue and North American heavy truck order rates.
